selected_feature.name: Pause/Resume
selected_feature.summary: STATE.PAUSED with P/Escape toggle, auto-pause on tab hide (visibilitychange), AudioContext suspend/resume via new game:pause/game:resume events, mobile pause button, window.Game.core.togglePause() API, resume safeTimer >= 0.6s grace.
acceptance_criteria: P or Escape while PLAYING enters STATE.PAUSED (value 3); overlay shows PAUSED title + resume CTA via existing ui.setOverlayText/showOverlay
While paused: dist, score, speed, spawn/combo/story timers and entity positions do not advance (ambient sky drift permitted)
P/Escape/Space/tap/click while PAUSED resumes with state intact, safeTimer raised to >= 0.6
Space or tap while PAUSED must NOT call startGame() (guard both call sites, core.js:56 and core.js:61)
visibilitychange to hidden during PLAYING auto-pauses
AudioContext suspended on game:pause, resumed on game:resume (null-guarded), wired inside audio.js via event listeners
JS-created HUD pause button, pointer-events auto, visible only while PLAYING, does not trigger touch-steer
No changes to gameplay tuning, biome thresholds 0/120/300, Flow x5, localStorage keys, script order, or import map; daynight.js/world.js/rider.js/story.js/vfx.js untouched

non_blocking_limitations: CDP smoke harness does not click #pauseBtn or simulate visibilitychange; those paths verified by code read + parent manual browser inspection (documented test gap, not a defect)
Audit findings F1-F4/H1-H4 remain open by design (report-only sprint)
final_audit.evidence: Orchestrator independently re-ran full verification gate post-commit: syntax 8/8, assets 10/10 -> 200, tell-check CLEAN, daynight sim pass, pause smoke 9/9; plus manual browser check of pause overlay/button state

grep -rnE 'TODO|FIXME|XXX|placeholder|STUB_REPLACE_ME' index.html css/ js/ || echo CLEAN
